title: Holdout-driven embedding quant profiles and cosine-stability gate for INT8/FP16
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Define and validate per-model INT8/FP16 quantization profiles for embedding models using a holdout-based calibration workflow and an automated cosine-stability gate. This ticket covers the calibration harness, holdout sampling strategy, evaluation metrics beyond raw cosine (e.g., pairwise rank preservation), and the production gate that blocks or flags profile rollouts when similarity drift exceeds operational thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A calibration harness that produces INT8 and FP16 quant profiles for a given embedding model and corpus using a configurable holdout fraction
Holdout evaluation reports that include mean cosine change, median rank-shift, and per-segment failure rates for at least three representative corpora
A runnable gating rule in the rollout pipeline that rejects profile promotion if mean cosine drop > 0.015 or rank-shift > 0.7 percentile
Documentation and runbook describing how to reproduce calibration and how on-call can triage a stability failure
A demo PR with one model (embed-v2-small) showing profile generation, evaluation dashboard link, and a successful canary rollout guarded by the gate
steps: Design holdout strategy: default 10% uniform + configurable stratified option per corpus
Implement calibration job that computes layer-aware quant parameters and emits a profile JSON compatible with serving runtime
Run evaluation on holdout: compute pairwise cosine distribution, delta histogram, rank preservation metrics, and downstream sim-based retrieval tests
Implement gating logic in rollout pipeline: ingest evaluation metrics and apply thresholds; on fail, create automatic rollback or flag for manual review
Instrument dashboards: aggregate per-model historical cosine deltas and alert when drift trends upward over 3 windows
Write runbook steps for on-call: how to identify false positives, rerun calibration with larger holdout, or fallback to FP16 baseline
comments: 2026-02-26 - Kickoff: scoped work with PM and SRE. Agreed on baseline thresholds (mean cosine drop 0.015). Action: Liam to prototype calibration job using existing embed-test-suite.

2026-03-02 - Prototype finished: calibration job emits profile artifact and evaluation CSV. Early results on embed-v2-small show mean cosine drop 0.009 for INT8, rank-shift median 0.3. Need broader corpora tests.

2026-03-05 - Design review: opted for holdout stratification by corpus shard to avoid underrepresenting tail distributions. Marco suggested adding per-dimension kurtosis check — deferred to follow-up ticket.
2026-03-08 - PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8472 implements calibration job and profile schema. Linked dashboard: grafana.redwood.ai/d/emb-quant/holdout-evals-72419

2026-03-10 - Canary run: deployed INT8 profile to dedicated canary pool for embed-v2-small. Observed a 0.012 mean cosine drop on production sampling (within gate). Scheduling broader run across 3 corpora next week.
notes: Trade-offs: INT8 provides ~2.4x token-cost savings for embedding inference but risks small downstream rank regressions. The gate is intentionally conservative initially. We will relax thresholds after one full month of low-severity canary runs. Future work: integrate FP8 experiment and automated per-corpus adaptive thresholds.
next_steps: Execute expanded evaluation on three production corpora (search-index, user-profiles, logs-archival)
Wire gating decision into rollout service with automated rollback on fail
Add automated notification to owners and create a summary ticket when gate fails
